sentences.text: Shri H.S. Rathore, Ga for respondent/State.

Heard on I.A. No.10683/2023, which is an application under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C./430 of the
Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on
behalf of appellant -
Rakesh Bagri.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code & Section 5(J),5(L)(ii)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to under 20-20 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.20,000-20,000/- for each of the offence with default stipulations.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, somebody had thrown the new born child in a dustbin.
Upon this police started the investigation and found the mother and upon her statement the present appellant was implicated and aforesaid offences were registered against the appellant.

Counsel for the appellant argued that as per prosecution story it is alleged that appellant had committed rape with the prosecutrix number of times and because of the same she got pregnant and delivered a child who was thrown in a dustbin.
He submits that no report was lodged for one year and thereafter the report has been lodged.
He further submits that appellant 2 CRA-4535-2020 has already undergone actual jail sentence of 7 years and 4 months.
Appeal is of the year 2020 and final hearing of the same may take time.
Hence, remaining jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended.
Counsel for the State has opposed the application by submitting that DNA was found positive.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration entirety of the evidence and the incarceration period, we deem it expedient to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Rakesh Bagri shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 12.08.2026, and thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code & Section 5(J),5(L)(ii)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to under 20-20 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.20,000-20,000/- for each of the offence with default stipulations.
As per prosecution story, somebody had thrown the new born child in a dustbin.
Upon this police started the investigation and found the mother and upon her statement the present appellant was implicated and aforesaid offences were registered against the appellant.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
Counsel for the appellant argued that as per prosecution story it is alleged that appellant had committed rape with the prosecutrix number of times and because of the same she got pregnant and delivered a child who was thrown in a dustbin.
He submits that no report was lodged for one year and thereafter the report has been lodged.
He further submits that appellant 2 CRA-4535-2020 has already undergone actual jail sentence of 7 years and 4 months.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Appeal is of the year 2020 and final hearing of the same may take time.
Hence, remaining jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration entirety of the evidence and the incarceration period, we deem it expedient to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No.10683/2023 stands allowed.
The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Rakesh Bagri shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 12.08.2026, and thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
